name: com.cgs.paytablelibrary
description: Paytable tooling for Konami/GEL and MCF slots: a reusable shell + block prefab library, the three Claude Code skills that drive it (shipped under Skills~, which Unity ignores), and the Paytable Tool editor window (PlayStudios > Slot Tools) that sets up the local environment and composes a run. Blocks are cloned and assembled per game, never edited in place. Requires TextMeshPro: built into com.unity.ugui on Unity 6, a separate package before that. It is deliberately not declared as a dependency here, because pinning the pre-Unity-6 registry version would conflict with the built-in module.
